contract.financial_qualification: Direct observations of the exact preserved PDF only. Original printed codes and semantic labels are explicitly mapped by the pinned primary authority profile. Values remain separate for every PDF SHA, including both2010copies; no preferred copy, aggregation, approval, native recalculation or filed-copy assertion.
contract.geometry_canonicalization: Exact source float coordinates remain unchanged exclusively inside geometry_evidence_json and printed_candidates_json UTF8 JSON STRINGS. Full-record canonical JSON contains only strings, nulls, booleans and integers; those evidence strings must never be parsed and rewritten before hashing or storage.
contract.hash_policy: Canonical UTF8 JSON with recursively sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, no NaN. Profile SHA is this canonical contract hash; full immutable record digests are separately allowlisted. Source geometry SHA is exact UTF8 geometry_evidence_json; candidate SHA is exact UTF8 printed_candidates_json.
contract.money_policy: A numeric slot requires all independently parsed actual occurrences to agree, with explicit printed cents. Blanks and held/missing fields remain null. No missing cents/blank becomes zero. Raw tokens, exact money edges, code glyphs and every original glyph instance are preserved.
contract.overstrike_policy: One visible glyph is projected only for identical text/geometry/font/size/color/upright/matrix/advance. Every exact duplicate remains in ordered raw evidence with multiplicity. Same-position differing glyphs or conflicting amounts are held; distinct amounts are never combined.
contract.source_PDF_policy: Exact existing eight-field public descriptor, original_print_output=true and immutable=true; no export_provenance or retained_office_provenance is added. Existing PDF metadata and content remain unchanged and are separately revalidated by the receiving service.
contract.source_identity_qualification: Person continuity is independently verified against exact taxpayer fields and available original source years; official printed year and every page owner are independently verified. No same-year native Info1, historical context, family or tax case is invented.
